title: How does a refrigerator work?
example: Follow heat from the food through a sealed cooling loop into the kitchen, then test an open door and look more closely at boiling.

nodes.label: The complete picture
nodes.question: How does a refrigerator keep food cold?
nodes.outcome: Trace heat into a colder coil, through refrigerant and compression, then out into the room.

nodes.label: Why the back is warm
nodes.question: Could an open fridge cool the kitchen?
nodes.outcome: Use a declared energy balance to distinguish a cold cabinet from both sides exchanging heat with the same room.

nodes.label: Boiling while cold
nodes.question: How can a cold liquid boil?
nodes.outcome: Explain why boiling depends on fluid and pressure, without confusing no boiling with no heat transfer.
